fact: WHO's SCORE assessment summary for Eritrea (data from 2013-2018, updated 15 March 2021) records, against the attribute that all CRVS data are exchanged electronically from local to regional offices and then to central offices, 'Paper-based system', with registration locations giving 'coverage only in urban areas' and CRVS framework and SOPs not defined.
title: SCORE for Health Data Technical Package: Assessment Summary for Eritrea
